buys.item: Lunch at a dhaba: dal, rice, roti

answer.thought: The body demands its satisfaction, and the system of needs provides it, however reluctantly. I shall consume this dal and rice with the dignity of a man who knows that the stomach is the first citizen of the state. The bookseller watches me with the patience of a man who has seen many hungry philosophers pass through his shop.

errors: that costs ₹220 and you have only ₹96 in cash
